nodes.label: Sentinel: setup and passive observation
nodes.summary: The conversation moves from setting up Sentinel’s Atlas/GitHub environment to observing text streams and producing structured activity nodes. Real local-model parsing remains pending.
nodes.evidence: I want it to watch a stream of output from an agent and push updates to atals as nodes are filled in/created.

nodes.label: Review the repository
nodes.summary: The assistant describes Sentinel as a React/Express audit-console prototype with an Atlas-backed gateway and deterministic demo replay.
nodes.evidence: This repo is **Sentinel**, a hackathon prototype for auditing AI agent actions.

nodes.label: Connect the application to Atlas
nodes.summary: The assistant reports the Sentinel project, free cluster, scoped database user, collections, and working application connection. This is a reported outcome from the transcript.
nodes.evidence: Done—Atlas is connected to the repo.

nodes.label: Find organizations and select Claudia’s org
nodes.summary: Two organizations were reported; the user chose Claudia’s organization using the MongoDB Atlas connection.
nodes.evidence: Claudia's Org - 2026-11-14 · MongoDB Atlas account

nodes.label: Initial project creation permission error
nodes.summary: The initial attempt lacked the Project Creator role. This historical failure was followed by a successful retry; it is not the current overall setup status.
nodes.evidence: the connected credentials lack the organization’s **Project Creator** role.

nodes.label: Create the project, cluster, and database user
nodes.summary: After the user requested another attempt, the assistant reported creating a free cluster and a user scoped to the sentinel database.
nodes.evidence: The project and free cluster were created successfully.

nodes.label: Unsupported built-in index declaration
nodes.summary: Setup initially failed when it attempted to recreate the built-in _id index with an unsupported option. Later setup and verification were reported successful.
nodes.evidence: it tries to recreate MongoDB’s built-in `_id` index with an unsupported option.

nodes.label: Verify Atlas reads, validation, and change streams
nodes.summary: The assistant reports passing connectivity, valid insert, invalid-event rejection, change-stream, and seeded-run checks.
nodes.evidence: Atlas verification passed: the app can connect, insert records, reject invalid audit events, and receive change-stream updates.

nodes.label: Complete and push the Phase 1 environment
nodes.summary: The transcript reports pushing the Atlas/GitHub environment setup to steffen/connect_mongo at commit e75ace9.
nodes.evidence: Pushed Phase 1 to `steffen/connect_mongo` — commit `e75ace9`.

nodes.label: Fix policy BSON types and optional audit fields
nodes.summary: Policy version/priority were explicitly stored as BSON Int32, undefined audit fields were omitted, and rule matching/priority were corrected.
nodes.evidence: policy version and priority values now use BSON `Int32`, and audit inserts omit undefined fields.

nodes.label: Approve a public synthetic-demo target
nodes.summary: The user explicitly allowed synthetic issues in the public itsnoor24/mongodb-hackathon repository after it was identified as public.
nodes.evidence: Use this public repo for synthetic demo issues

nodes.label: Create and read back GitHub issue #2
nodes.summary: The assistant reports creating synthetic issue #2, reading it back, and recording issueNumber 2 in Atlas. The disallowed target was reported never dispatched.
nodes.evidence: It created synthetic GitHub issue **#2**, read it back, and saved `issueNumber: 2` in the Atlas completion event.

nodes.label: Prepare team handoff instructions
nodes.summary: A handoff document for Persons 2 and 3 was included with the Phase 1 push.
nodes.evidence: [Handoff for Persons 2 and 3](C:/Users/Steff/git/mongodb-hackathon/docs/phase-1-handoff.md) is included.

nodes.label: Browser visual acceptance remains pending
nodes.summary: Automated replay/tree checks passed according to the assistant, but browser visual acceptance was left to Person 3 after a sandbox error.
nodes.evidence: Visual browser acceptance remains pending because browser automation hit the Windows sandbox error.

nodes.label: Implement passive text-stream capture
nodes.summary: The assistant reports implementing HTTP text ingestion, piped stdin, Atlas persistence, and an observer UI on a separate local branch.
nodes.evidence: The ingestion endpoint and observer view are in place.

nodes.label: Create a local implementation branch
nodes.summary: The assistant reports creating steffen/text-stream-local-llm from Phase 1; subsequent work remained local and uncommitted at the captured point.
nodes.evidence: Created and switched to **`steffen/text-stream-local-llm`**

nodes.label: Consume UTF-8 text and append raw frames
nodes.summary: The endpoint was reported to decode UTF-8 across transport boundaries, persist bounded frames, and accept additional text for an existing stream.
nodes.evidence: The endpoint decodes UTF-8 across network chunks, saves bounded text frames to Atlas, and accepts more text on the same stream ID.

nodes.label: Exercise live capture and failure recovery
nodes.summary: The assistant reports tests covering persistence before EOF, disconnect retention, concurrent-writer rejection, and parser-error retryability, plus a stdin smoke test.
nodes.evidence: They confirmed that text is saved before the upload ends, disconnected uploads retain committed frames, concurrent writers are rejected, and parser failures leave the transcript available for retry.

nodes.label: Provide an optional local parser adapter
nodes.summary: The assistant reports an optional Ollama adapter for producing structured nodes. It was checked using a mock server rather than a configured local model.
nodes.evidence: An optional local Ollama parser can produce structured nodes; no model is configured yet.

nodes.label: Select and validate a real local model
nodes.summary: The captured conversation does not show a configured or running local LLM. Actual local-model inference remains unverified.
nodes.evidence: I haven’t found an Ollama server locally, so I’ll test the parser contract with a mock server and leave real inference unverified.

nodes.label: Replay mock terminal output
nodes.summary: The assistant reports streaming and saving 12 synthetic incident-triage lines. This was a raw-capture demonstration, with parsed nodes empty at that time.
nodes.evidence: 12 mock terminal lines streamed and saved to Atlas.
